objectives.sub_subject_name: Earth & Environmental Sciences (The Earth God Formed)
objectives.objective_text: Identify everyday actions at home and school that conserve natural resources such as water, paper, and energy.

objectives.sub_subject_name: Earth & Environmental Sciences (The Earth God Formed)
objectives.objective_text: Obtain and combine information about ways individual communities use science ideas to protect the Earth's resources and environment.

standards: NGSS 5-ESS3-1 — Obtain and combine information about ways individual communities use science ideas to protect the Earth' (grades 5)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Earth & Environmental Sciences (The Earth God Formed)
objectives.objective_text: Design a method for monitoring and minimizing a specific human impact on the local environment.

standards: NGSS MS-ESS3-3 — Apply scientific principles to design a method for monitoring and minimizing a human impact on the envir (grades 6-8)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Earth & Environmental Sciences (The Earth God Formed)
objectives.objective_text: Evaluate a technological solution that reduces the impacts of human activities on natural systems.

standards: NGSS HS-ESS3-4 — Evaluate or refine a technological solution that reduces impacts of human activities on natural systems (grades 9-12)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Earth & Environmental Sciences (The Earth God Formed)
objectives.objective_text: Refine a stewardship solution by weighing its costs, benefits, and long-term trade-offs for sustaining resources.

standards: NGSS HS-ESS3-4 — Evaluate or refine a technological solution that reduces impacts of human activities on natural systems (grades 9-12)
